oracle_shims: interpol.pro (GDL's own lib/utilities/interpol.pro, not a shim)
print_field.pro (generic column-major hex/int printer, unused by this bank's own printed fields but kept for parity with run_soda2_process_2d_bank.py's extra_files set)
determinism: checked: two full runs, CSV (minus line 3) and netCDF variable digests equal

diam.longname: Particle diameter from circle fit. No Poisson spot size corrections applied

xsize.longname: X-size (across array). No Poisson spot size corrections applied

ysize.longname: Y-size (along airflow). No Poisson spot size corrections applied

xextent.longname: Maximum x-size (across array) for a single slice. No Poisson spot size corrections applied

oned.longname: 1-D emulation size. Number of latched pixels. No Poisson spot size corrections applied

twod.longname: 2-D emulation size. Maximum number of shaded pixels on a single slice. No Poisson spot size corrections applied

areasize.longname: Equivalent area size. No Poisson spot size corrections applied

arearatiofilled.longname: Area ratio with particle voids filled

areafilled.longname: Number of shaded pixels including voids

perimeterarea.longname: Number of shaded pixels on particle perimeter

area75.longname: Number of shaded pixels at the 75% (or grey level-3) shading

dofflag.longname: Depth of field flag from probe, if available (1=accepted)

sizecorrection.longname: Size correction factor from Korolev 2007 (D_edge/D0). Use to adjust sizes in this file if necessary

probetas.longname: True air speed for probe clock

aircrafttas.longname: True air speed for aircraft (if available)

orientation.longname: Particle orientation relative to array axis

rejectionflag.longname: Particle rejection code (see soda2_reject.pro for codes)

numregions.longname: Number of connected regions (blobs) in the particle image, if the KEEP_LARGEST option is enabled

diodegaps.longname: Number of unshaded diodes between the first and last shaded diodes

name: frame_csv_only
note: CSV only; sentinel_exit stays on regardless (harmless, no ncdf_* call)

name: frame_images
note: PBP netCDF with particle images (ncdfparticlefile=2); soda2_process_2d.pro shim drops CHUNK= at :303 (GDL rejects it), so values are oracle-derived and the on-disk layout is NOT validated
